title: Growth SE 1:1 prep — Ellis (scratchpad)
content:
Meeting context: weekly 1:1 with Lina (CSM) — focus is top-of-funnel retention signals, two enterprise POCs, and SE enablement asks. Quick, informal — use as scratchpad.

Goals for this 1:1:
- Surface any immediate technical blockers Lina is seeing with Accounts: DeltaHealth POC and Atlas Logistics demo.
- Align on action plan to close integrations work for DeltaHealth before next exec review (target milestone: 2026-03-25).
- Decide whether to recommend a canary model fallback for Atlas (latency vs. quality tradeoff).
- Capture enablement needs for new AE hires (demo checklist + sandbox credentials).

Opening / icebreaker (2 min):
- Quick wins from last week: Atlas demo trimmed 120ms off median generator latency after kv-cache tuning (note: still seeing tail spikes).
- Personal note: Lina mentioned family travel Fri — ask if reschedule needed for exec sync.

Top tickets / signals to call out (bring triage):
- GTM-4821: DeltaHealth connector errors on onboarding — observed 502s when dataset >20k tokens, likely causes: streaming timeouts + memory config. I started a repro. Current hypothesis: per-request max_seq param too low for long docs.
- INF-3310: Atlas quantized variant shows hallucination cases in billing table extraction — SE investigation ongoing.
- SRE-1202: intermittent TLS renegotiation on dedicated pool in us-west1 — affects demo stability (~1/200).

Questions to ask Lina:
- Which account is highest risk for churn this quarter? Any new escalations I should be looped into?
- For DeltaHealth, do we have an exec-level dry run scheduled? If yes, who will own the runbook?
- Any blockers on security review for private deployment demo? (need list of required artifacts)

Talking points / suggestions I'll bring:
- Short-term mitigations for DeltaHealth: bump per-request buffer, enable prefix caching for document ingestion, send smaller chunked requests from their ingestion pipeline. I can demo change in staging by EOD Tuesday.
- For Atlas hallucination issue: propose A/B to route sensitive extraction requests to full-precision variant; need Lina sign-off for customer-facing impact.
- For TLS flakiness: recommend SRE quick patch + retry logic on our client SDK (I can draft PR with exponential backoff).

Quick demo plan (5–8 min):
- Show staging repro of DeltaHealth 502s and quick config flip to resolve; bring log snippet and new request timeline.
- If time, show comparison of quantized vs. fp16 outputs for a billing table case (highlight differences).

Notes-to-self (raw):
- Prep logs: /staging/logs/deltahealth/2026-03-11-*. Need to snapshot before demo.
- Bring 2 slides: 1) proposed mitigation steps + owners 2) expected customer impact + timeline.
- Check with infra on quota bump for dedicated pool if we route Atlas to fp variant for canary.

Proposed decision points (goal by EOD after meeting):
- Approve short-term buffer increase for DeltaHealth ingestion (owner: Ellis) — due 2026-03-17.
- Approve canary routing for Atlas sensitive extracts to fp model for 3-day test (owner: Lina) — decision by 2026-03-16.
- Agree on runbook owner for exec dry run (owner candidate: Omar) — confirm now.

Action items (explicit, assign and date):
- Ellis: prepare staging demo for DeltaHealth buffer flip + create PR with config explanation — due 2026-03-17.
- Lina: confirm whether exec dry run is on 2026-03-24 or needs reschedule; if on, share list of exec attendees — due 2026-03-14.
- Omar: validate SRE quick patch bandwidth and reply with ETA; list any infra constraints for routing to fp model — due 2026-03-15.
- Maya: update AE demo checklist with two new items (kv-cache flag, fallback routing instructions) — due 2026-03-18.
- Lina + Ellis: draft customer-facing mitigation note for DeltaHealth (one-pager) — due 2026-03-19.

Follow-ups I want from Lina in next 48h:
- Confirmation which account exec needs the runbook.
- Permission to perform fp-route canary for Atlas on a subset of requests.

Risks / escalations if decisions delayed:
- DeltaHealth exec review slips (risk to renewal window).
- Atlas billing extraction regressions create extra support load for CS team.

Handy snippets to paste in Slack during meeting:
- "Quick demo ready: staging repro + buffer change — show fixes in ~3m. If we can flip per-request buffer and enable prefix caching, I expect 95th pct latency drop of ~30% for ingestion flows."
- "Recommend 3-day fp-routing canary for critical extracts; will monitor hallucination rate and token cost delta.
  If Lina OK, I'll schedule and loop infra."

Loose parking lot (things to handle later):
- Build a KB article: "Avoiding long-doc 502s" with code snippets for chunked ingestion. (owner: Ellis/Maya).
- Add a short eval harness for billing table extraction comparing quantized vs fp outputs.

End-of-meeting checklist (before hangup):
- Confirm immediate owners and due dates for the 5 action items above.
- Ask Lina if any handoffs to AEs are required or if she wants me to lead demo with an AE present.
- Agree time for a follow-up sync (15 min) to validate mitigation metrics after demo — propose 2026-03-18 morning.

Version notes / history:
- 2026-03-09: initial draft (raw notes after Slack thread).
- 2026-03-11: added ticket GTM-4821 repro steps.
- 2026-03-13: refined action items and set due dates.

End of scratchpad.
